changes.title: Make UIMSD Columns tour step editable after grouped tables
changes.text: The tour's Weapons summary is grouped, where the Columns button only explains that grouping prevents column editing. Moving into the Columns lesson now switches only the separate tour-owned model to an ungrouped editable table. Normal advance, Skip, Previous and direct Guide entry use the same preparation; a real column toggle, not ungrouping alone, completes the lesson. No real-player history, view or saves are mutated.
